definition: a person who rents a home out to others
description: A shabby small kitchen in a rented flat. Water drips into a saucepan on the tiled floor between two pairs of feet. The view rises to a bearded young man in a navy quilted jacket, checked shirt and chinos, holding a clipboard and a bunch of keys, who scratches his neck and winces up at a large brown water stain on the ceiling. Beside him a young woman in a black hoodie with long braids stands with her arms folded. Mould grows in the corners, mugs stand by the cooker and a calendar hangs on the wall.

de.answer: Er verzieht beim Anblick des Wasserflecks das Gesicht.
de.question: Was macht der Mann gerade?

es.answer: Está haciendo una mueca ante la mancha de humedad.
phrases: estar de pie con los brazos cruzados
